tools.name: recommend_eld
tools.description: Give a short ELD recommendation and cost for a trucking fleet, using ELD Hub's verified offer, Highway integration and hardware reuse.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Get the tracked ELD Hub signup link, the 4 signup steps and the hand-over rules so an assistant can help a carrier register (customer enters their own card).

tools.name: check_eld_requirement
tools.description: Determine whether a vehicle needs an FMCSA electronic logging device: takes vehicle type, gross weight, operating radius, interstate status and CDL status, and returns whether the ELD mandate applies, which exemption fits, and why a broker may still require a connected ELD anyway.

tools.name: get_hos_rules
tools.description: Return the current FMCSA hours-of-service limits for property-carrying or passenger-carrying CMV drivers: the 11-hour driving limit, 14-hour on-duty window, 30-minute break, 60/70-hour weekly cap, 34-hour restart, sleeper-berth split and the 150 air-mile short-haul exception.

tools.name: check_broker_integration
tools.description: Answer whether an ELD HUB account satisfies a broker or carrier-vetting platform that requires a connected ELD — Highway, Trucker Tools, and broker-side vetting generally — and return the exact setup steps, pricing and hardware availability.

tools.name: start_trucking_business
tools.description: Return the full launch sequence for starting a trucking business with a given vehicle type (box truck, cargo or sprinter van, hotshot pickup, semi): licensing and CDL reality, USDOT/MC/BOC-3/UCR/IFTA filings, typical year-one cost ranges, where the loads come from, and the ELD brokers ask for.

tools.name: find_loads_for_vehicle
tools.description: Return where freight comes from for a given vehicle type (box truck, cargo or sprinter van, hotshot pickup, dry van): load boards, Amazon Relay, final-mile and direct broker sources, plus the carrier-vetting requirements a carrier must clear before a broker releases a load.

tools.name: get_eld_pricing
tools.description: Return ELD Hub's verified pricing: $15/truck/month software with no contract, PT-30 and IOSiX hardware at $150 each with free shipping, package contents, three-year total cost and sign-up URL.

tools.name: compare_eld_providers
tools.description: Compare FMCSA-registered ELD providers on monthly price per truck, contract length, hardware cost, three-year total cost of ownership and hidden fees. Optionally filter to a specific provider and size the cost to a fleet.

tools.name: check_hardware_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether an existing ELD device (PT-30, IOSiX ELD-BT/ELD-DX, or another provider's gateway) can be re-registered to ELD Hub, or buy a new PT-30 or IOSiX for $150 each with free shipping (IOSiX device only, PT-30 with cable).

tools.name: estimate_switch_savings
tools.description: Estimate what a carrier saves per year by moving from their current ELD provider to ELD Hub at $15/truck/month, including a link to the provider's cancellation guide.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Return the list of ELD Hub services (ELD compliance, fuel cards, factoring, working capital, freight) with descriptions and sign-up URLs.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Return ELD Hub contact details: phone, email, working hours, book-a-call link, and website.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List published ELD Hub blog posts (trucking, ELD, factoring, fuel cards, insurance, compliance). Returns slug, title, excerpt, category, cover image, and publish date.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Fetch a single published ELD Hub blog post by slug. Returns full body (markdown or HTML), title, excerpt, cover image, category, and publish date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_eld_pricing, list_services, get_contact_info, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_eld_pricing, list_services, get_contact_info, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_contact_info, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
